item.title: Microsoft Defender Part 3: Microsoft Defender for Cloud (The One That's Actually Different)
item.description: Microsoft Defender for Cloud is the one product in the Defender family most people confuse with Defender XDR — and the mistake is costly. Different portal, different licensing, different audience. A friendly, honest walk through what it is, how its two layers fit together, and which plans matter for Azure, AWS, and GCP workloads.
